facts.fact: 章首：马背上睡醒——整夜被搂在胸前同乘 Bayard；抵残破村庄
facts.anchor: Gerrick sat behind her atop Bayard. One hand held the reins, while the other lay tucked against Andra’s ribcage

facts.fact: 下令穿村直奔北端：不停不接触；沿途断壁/醉汉/脏脸孩童/婴儿啼哭
facts.anchor: “We’ll need to keep going until we reach the northern end of the village. Don’t stop, don’t interact.”

facts.fact: 她问“能帮他们吗”——Gerrick 摇头“Not tonight”
facts.anchor: “Is there anything we can do to help them?” she whispered.

facts.fact: 妓院街区：门口女子熟络招呼 Gerrick“好久没来”——他是常客；她冷言“物件论”
facts.anchor: “It’s been so long since you’ve come to see us, Gerrick. We’ve missed you.” The other woman pouted.

facts.fact: 暗廊撞雪肤鸦发女子——她点头同意被吻：“那一刻什么都不重要”
facts.anchor: Soft lips closed over Andra’s, and in that moment nothing else mattered.

facts.fact: Gerrick 打断：Nelveen=北方林子联络人；她称他“Gerrick of Sarkovia”
facts.anchor: “Andra, I see you’ve met my contact in the Northern Woods.”

facts.fact: 来意：要情报——Nelveen 仍是他最好的来源
facts.anchor: “We need information, Nelveen. You’re still my best source,” Gerrick answered.

facts.fact: Nelveen 私语教订“私人团体房”指名找她——随即高声告辞打掩护
facts.anchor: You need to book a ‘private group room’. Ask for me, and only me.

facts.fact: 独处对峙：Gerrick 点破“我让你第一次感到活着”——她手中酒杯泛橙光险些捏碎
facts.anchor: The cup in Andra’s hand glowed orange, and quickly she set it down on the table before she broke it.

facts.fact: 隔壁 alcove：男人盘问妓女见没见过“Andra 或 Gerrick”——“Official business. For Vasara”
facts.anchor: “You sure, baby?” the man asked roughly. “No one by the name of Andra? Or Gerrick?”

facts.fact: 醉汉扯她斗篷——Gerrick 扼喉+砸头桌沿昏死血泊；“Anyone else?”
facts.anchor: The man slumped to the floor, unconscious, blood pooling on the floor around his head.

facts.fact: 章末：两段楼梯三扇破旧门走向最后一扇——Gerrick 抬手敲门
facts.anchor: Gerrick reached behind him and rapped on the wooden door.
